summary: Locale-aware comparison of two bounded ANSI string buffers. On first call it detects whether CompareStringW is functional by probing it with a known test string; based on the outcome it caches a compare mode (1 = wide, 2 = ANSI) in a global. Mode 2 compares with CompareStringA directly. Mode 1 converts both strings to wide characters with MultiByteToWideChar and compares with CompareStringW, with special empty-string/DBCS lead-byte ordering handled via GetCPInfo. Returns 0 on failure.

operations.description: On first use (cached mode global is zero), probe CompareStringW with the test string String2 and cache mode 1 if it succeeds; otherwise probe CompareStringA with test string String1 and cache mode 2, returning 0 if that also fails.
Cap the input lengths: when each count is positive, replace it with BoundedStringLengthWithCap of the corresponding string; otherwise keep the raw count.
ANSI path: when the cached mode is 2, return CompareStringA(Locale, dwCmpFlags, lpString1, length1, lpString2, length2).
Wide path setup: when the cached mode is 1 and no explicit code page was passed, fall back to the default CodePage global.

Empty-string ordering: when either capped length is zero, return 2 when both lengths are equal, otherwise use GetCPInfo and the DBCS lead-byte table to decide which single byte sorts first, returning 0 when code page info is unavailable.

Convert the first string to wide: query the required wide-character count via MultiByteToWideChar(CodePage, 9, lpString1, length1, 0, 0), reserve a rounded stack buffer with alloca (guarded by __alloca_probe), and perform the conversion.
Convert the second string to wide the same way, with its own width query, allocation and conversion.
Compare the two wide strings with CompareStringW and return its result; any failed conversion falls through to 0.
Return 0 on every failure path: unavailable compare API, failed code page probe, or failed wide conversion.

clean_pseudocode: int LocaleCompareStringAnsi(LCID loc, DWORD flags, const char* s1, int n1, const char* s2, int n2, UINT cp) {
int l1 = n1 > 0 ? BoundedStringLengthWithCap(s1, n1) : n1;
if (g_mode == 2) return CompareStringA(loc, flags, s1, l1, s2, n2);
/* empty-string and DBCS lead-byte ordering via GetCPInfo; on failure return 0 */
/* reserve wide buffers, convert both, then */
return CompareStringW(loc, flags, wbuf1, w1, wbuf2, w2);
